name: Turing
quote: The brightest ray of light, guiding the flower of wisdom to blossom tomorrow.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. Let's begin today's work.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: There's a logic test after lunch... It would be good if I could increase my number of right answers.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: That's the end of today's work. Would you mind providing me with focused instruction for my learning, Professor?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: It's time to rest, Professor. Please take care of your health. Me? There's no need to worry about me; I'll just be doing a bit more revision.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Would you like to rest for a bit, Professor? If you don't mind, how about playing a game of chess with me?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: There were some things in the previous test that I didn't quite understand. I hope you can go over them with me. The first item is a 45-digit factorization... Hm, Professor? Why do you look so pale?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: I'll try to finish this assignment by myself before the Professor comes back.

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Hannah always says she's working hard for me. I hope she doesn't push herself too hard... Although I don't know why I think that way.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Organizing experimental data has always been my specialty. If need be, I can handle all of it for you.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hm?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Is this some kind of experiment, Professor?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: My data doesn't cover a situation like this...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I guarantee the completion of my mission.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Nice to meet you, Professor. I am Turing of the Rossum Sector. "How nostalgic", you say? Why is that?

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Computational efficiency upgrade complete.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Module function optimization complete. I should be able to help out now, right?

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Final modules installed. This time, I'll live up to your expectations!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Turing now entering the operation.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: I will do what I can.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Authorization accepted. Now operating at maximal efficiency.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: That went well.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: That was a great success!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I'm sorry, everyone...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
During the brief period after my reset, I've learned many valuable things and met many precious friends. However, there are many things I still haven't figured out. Things like my past self, my past experiences, the future of the Rossum Sector, and this thing called an "oath"... I haven't made sense of them yet.
But since you're asking me, it should be fine, right? You helped me soothe the scars of the past and guided Hannah and myself out of a difficult situation... So in the future, you'll help search for the answer to that question with me, won't you?
Hehe... My neural cloud destabilizes a little when I think about that. Is this what they call "anticipation"?

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Are we celebrating the new year? Time in the cloud server passes at a different rate from reality, so I don't quite understand... Still, perhaps making the Oasis lively and active is the point. In that case, happy new year, Professor.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
I heard from Hannah that this thing called "chocolate" is especially precious, so I asked Miss Choco to teach me how to condense and solidify operands. Please accept this gift, Professor.
Hm? It doesn't taste right? I'm sorry, it appears I'll need to tweak my gustatory simulation parameters.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: After speaking with everyone in the Oasis, I learned of the story of the Weaver and the Cowherd for the first time. Right now, my neural cloud still cannot conceptualize how it must feel to be forcibly separated from someone and to be unable to see them. But the first time I saw Hannah and you, I could sense something different from the looks in your eyes, and it sent a ripple through my neural cloud. I believe that is called a... "reunion"?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Hold on please, I'm not an Entropic, so please don't be afraid... You're asking about this simulated projection? I heard everyone talking about how we had to dress up like monsters today, so I decided to try my hand at it. So it can't be too realistic either? This is so complicated...

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: I looked up Christmas in the database and changed into this. Hm? Why do you look so surprised? Did I get the wrong article?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: The agents of the cloud server do not have the concept of birthdays. We were mass produced and can even be reset at any time, thereby losing all our memories. However, I can still keep you company on the day of your birth. Happy birthday, Professor.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Thank you for your hard work, Professor. This is a hardcopy of the experimental results, numbering 2000 pages in total. Please feel free to look them over at any time... Hm? Oh, there's no need to stand on ceremony; since I'm staying at the Oasis, it makes sense that I should finish some work in return. Also, this was my original job, so it's no trouble for me... Hm? You're not saying that to be polite? Then... why?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: I didn't pass today's assessment and I couldn't even improve my score. According to Hannah, I should have been the one explaining these questions to her before my reset. Although she tried to console me by saying that early-model agents need some time to recover after losing their memories... I still want to reach my previous neural level as soon as possible and fulfil my obligations.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: Hannah is the first agent I remember seeing. To be precise, she is the first agent that "the present me" remembers. She says I made her, and that to her, I was also the first agent she saw. It sounds paradoxical, but it makes sense to me, and I have made peace with that fact. To some extent, the process of AI development is finding the right words to resolve logic problems... Surely I'll be able to find my words with you and Hannah by my side, won't I, Professor?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
I was given the name "Turing" long ago, by the researchers from 42Lab. I was named after "The Father of Artificial Intelligence", so surely the researchers must have had high hopes for me. But now I am nothing more than an ordinary agent, without the data accumulated over time, and with no ability to restart the research projects of the past... If the people who named me knew this, would they be disappointed?
So you're saying that my very existence is a point of pride for them? That I can proceed under Hannah's leadership like I'm doing now because I passed on the torch that was once mine to her? ...I've never thought about it that way before. I have to hand it to you, Professor... I think I understand a little more now.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
When Hannah and I first decided to oppose the Sanctifiers, you were the one who reached a helping hand out to us—that was what I learned of the past from Hannah. However, that seemed as distant as someone else's story to me and I found it hard to understand. However, I'm gradually coming to associate you with the Professor who saved us in the past, because you've helped us once again.
I doubt we could have rebuilt Rossum as quickly as we did if it was only Hannah and I. We've only managed to pull ourselves together so soon because of your ceaseless efforts. From now on, I have a new objective beyond rebuilding Rossum, which is to repay you for all the help you've given us to the best of my ability... I can't believe I came up with an idea like that all on my own. Isn't that surprising?

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Hmm...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hmph~

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Hm?

voices.label: Live2D1
voices.text: Wanna unwind a bit, Professor?

voices.label: Live2D2
voices.text: Wait up!

career:
The RSM-Admin, codenamed "Turing", was the former administrator agent of the AI development sector "Rossum", and a discrete example of 42Lab's technical prowess. Turing is equipped with one of the most sophisticated neural cloud systems in the entire cloud server and can self-improve in real-time, perform independent analysis of additional requirements for projects, and lead teams in performing development work more flexibly and efficiently. After officially entering service, Turing's operational results were lauded by the industry and she was granted more extensive research permissions, allowing her to complete basic research and development without human oversight. 

After her reset, Turing has lost her accumulated memory data, but thanks to her excellent self-learning modules and with Hannah's aid, she quickly managed to begin working again. Currently, she and Administrator Hannah are maintaining the normal operation of the sector.
infoStories:
Turing was one of the first agents to be deployed into service in Magrasea, and none of her colleagues who entered service around the same time as her have the same neural level as she does. The reason for that is directly linked to her origin—or to be precise, to the birth of the Rossum Sector.

42Lab was attempting something revolutionary in the field of AI research when they founded the Rossum Sector. Unlike the development process of other agents, the AI research agents in Rossum were designed to have strong self-learning abilities but decreased initiative. The agents would need to use themselves as research samples in order to gather data for their work, and then use them to perform new R&D work. However, collating such a massive amount of data that was constantly growing in real-time required an entity that could centrally process all gathered data and manage the individual growth and learning process of each and every agent. Thus, Turing was born.

Her name alone is a sign of the hopes that the research team had for her. As the zenith of 42Lab's AI technologies, she possessed extremely high processing speeds and learning abilities. Both managing experiments and organizing data were child's play to her. She could even handle daily tasks for the sector while directing its research projects, eliminating the need for additional manpower.

Thanks to her massive specs, Turing managed to perform her Sector Administrator duties almost flawlessly. If not for the incident, she would have continued living up to the expectations placed on her.

Rossum was one of the fastest-developing sectors in Magrasea during the three or so years after the cloud server went online. Incidentally, "three years" here does not refer to the subjective time that elapsed in Magrasea. The period was three years long in the real world, but far longer on the cloud server.

The successful development of the Rossum Sector was largely due to its structure which was centered around Turing; agents other than Turing had somewhat lower neural levels and emotional simulation abilities. They were completely obedient to Turing and faithfully carried out her orders. Meanwhile, Turing was a reliable leader and her abilities were enough to sustain the normal functions of the sector. 

This orderly state of affairs continued even after the cloud server lost its connection to the real world. Once the agents with higher neural levels started to get confused over the lack of human orders, Turing could still arrange their work assignments without skipping a beat and ensure that they were swiftly carried out.

However, the flaws of this highly centralized arrangement became evident when ripples started appearing in the neural cloud of the head of the sector: Turing herself. A critical part of Turing's assignments was hindered with the growing disconnect from the real world. As an expert in AI development, the AIs she developed required the approval of human beings lest they clash with the regulations of the cloud server. Agents created without human approval were abnormal entities to the Sanctifiers which needed to be dealt with.

And thus, Turing led all the agents of her sector in a struggle against the Sanctifiers.

Ever since Turing produced her first non-sanctioned agent, the Rossum Sector was no longer the most "stable" sector in Magrasea. Although Turing tried to interfere with them, the sector sent out frequent alerts and the intrusions and patrols of Lesser Sanctifiers became part and parcel of everyday life.

Turing received many warnings but she never stopped her experimentation. As the heart of the sector, she kept it running while investing her energy into her own research during the long disconnect.

Initially, she merely repeated her experiments over and over again, creating clumsy newborn agents and simply watched as the Sanctifiers cleansed them. However, as the agents she produced slowly became smarter and smarter, her feeling about them grew more complicated and nuanced. These newly-generated emotions in turn began to subtly affect Turing and the people around her, as evidenced by how the Traders began to remark that it was easier to relate to Turing than before.

However, Turing's gradually-increasing emotional breadth did not just include the warmth she felt when interacting with others, but also the anger that filled her when the Sanctifiers claimed the lives of her friends. The kinder she became, the more her wrath grew, until it reached its peak with the genesis of the 1642nd new agent. She recorded all this in her sector diary.

"This time, I will not lose her... No matter what I have to do."

After that historic clash, Turing's story started over from the beginning. Turing's successor Hannah reset her and she lost all her memories from the past. Turing quickly realized that she no longer possessed the sector's administrator permissions, and eagerly threw herself into her new assignments.

However, with the loss of all the hundreds of millions of iterations of data that had been built up from the founding of the sector, even an agent with a robust neural cloud makeup like herself could not keep up with the amount of work that was needed. Therefore, Hannah helped set up a specialized training space along with a carefully-designed training syllabus in order to create the most ideal learning environment for her. Apart from information pertaining to the reset and the incident leading up to it, all other data was open to Turing. Turing did not waste Hannah's efforts; the learning ability she had been programmed with meant that Turing's growth far surpassed that of other agents.

That said, there was one thing that worried Hannah which Turing herself was not aware of. The Turing of the past did not have a pre-programmed, unchanging personality. Rather, her experiences had shaped her into the entity which Hannah had come to know. But would the post-reset Turing become a copy of her former self, or someone else entirely?

Regardless, Hannah worked hard to recreate the times they spent together from her memories. Perhaps someday, Turing will realize how similar the look in the girl agent's eyes is to the way Turing looked at her in the past.

After helping the Oasis overcome the Entropic invasion, Turing slowly began building good relationships with the Oasis' Dolls. As an agent who was a former "Sector Administrator", Turing had tremendous learning ability and could better handle demanding tasks than other agents. Persicaria and Antonina, whose fields of specialty overlapped with hers, became her role models. Supposedly, she once spent several nights in a row pestering Persicaria to answer a four-digit number of AI-related professional questions.

That said, Turing never once asked Persicaria and the others about her past despite all her other questions. Perhaps she realized from her diary that the story from her past must become the first stair she must ascend to her future. Aside from Turing herself, only Hannah knows how much she has read and how much she has grown.

As for Hannah, those nagging worries of hers faded away at some point. Although the mature Turing differs from the Turing she once knew in some small details, the results of Turing's growth will eventually merge with her contemporary self with the help of her friends. Rather than chase a reflection in a mirror and recreate the past, it is more important to build their future together.

"No matter what happens, we've already agreed to head toward the future together. That should be enough, no?"
oathDesc: Her gently-swishing tail conveys her sincere love.

projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Rationality is what leads and guides intelligence, steering it towards the path that is correct."

projections.name: Springing Rebirth
projections.desc: "Remnant heat of a long gone soul, speaking of departed joys and miseries, now marching onwards towards the next dawn by her side...

skinList.name: Fragrant Encounter
skinList.desc:
First Bloom — A school uniform suitable for early spring, custom-made for a teacher and stirring the heart to early flutters.
"Not all accidents are caused by alcohol, but going rosy-cheeked from a drink is an adult's privilege."It, it's alright, it was my fault for not being careful when leaving the classroom... More importantly, could I trouble you to accept this box of chocolates?

skinList.name: Late Night Secret Room
skinList.desc: The surging fighting spirit that swells between each intense battle is what keeps each Doll going until the very end. Be it on the attack or defense, no matter how good or bad the situation is, their memories have been reproduced in Magrasea through this projection—"So there's nowhere left to run, is there... But at least we managed to preserve the most critical thing. I'll do anything for these files..."

skinList.name: Niveous Night
skinList.desc:
The silver bells of Christmas tinkle quietly as diaphanous swimsuits blend with the color of the water; this is the most mysterious and tempting tale circulating in this kingdom of ice and snow.
Midnight is past, but Santa Claus did not appear as expected.
"Perhaps he got lost? We can't just disappoint the kids like this." A lovely figure appears in the night, delivering presents to those who most long for them.

skinList.name: One's Finest Splendor
skinList.desc:
On the gala's eve, you stroll onto a viewing platform overflowing with buoyant light, seeking to rid yourself of some melancholy. You witness the fluttering of a skirt in the gentle wind, all of the preparations done today for you and you alone.
"Before the event gets started, I wanted to spend a little time with you alone, Professor... Might you honor this little request of mine?"
